results.content: # Tampa physician, nurse practitioner killed in Hillsborough County plane crash. Updated September 4, 2026 at 1:39 PM EDT. ## Officials identified the pilot as Dr. David Siambanes, 59, and the passenger as Dawn Stone, 53. Simbanes was director of the scoliosis center at St. Joseph's Children's Hospital, while Stone was a nurse practitioner for AdventHealth. The crash happened in a wooded area off North U.S. 301 in Tampa. "Our hearts are heavy this evening as we learned about the passing of Dr. David Siambanes who died in a plane crash this morning in Tampa. “We are heartbroken by the passing of Dawn Stone, a valued and deeply cared-for member of our AdventHealth family. Our thoughts and pray

A former Catholic priest and respected human resources executive and recruiter, David was known for his kindness, wisdom, and devotion to others. He is survived by his wife, Susan (nee Thieme); his brother, Robert (Barbara) Franzone; and many nieces, nephews, cousins, friends, and colleagues. Memorial service September 8, 2026, at 11:00 a.m., visitation at 10:00 a.m., Grace Lutheran Church and School, River Forest, IL. In lieu of flowers memorials appreciated to Bach Cantata Vespers at Grace Lutheran Church, WTTW, WB
